look_here_first: Find paired pale straight stipular spines and bipinnate leaves. Yellow spherical flower heads resemble huisache. A VERY NARROW elongated pod versus the thick short hard huisache pod is the strongest comparison.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Paired straight pale spines at nodes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Yellow globose heads of many little flowers

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Long narrow pod relative to its width
